title: Night drive
approach: A lone driver crosses a sleeping city after midnight. Four beats, five seconds each: the car wakes, the city slides past, a red light holds, the road opens out. Music carries it; no words.

beats.brief: The dashboard lights up in a dark garage. The hook: a face lit from below.
beats.shot: Close-up inside a parked car at night, a dashboard glowing amber, the driver's face lit from below, breath fogging the cold air, shallow depth of field, cinematic, 35 mm film grain.

beats.brief: Wide street, neon reflections on wet asphalt, the car small in frame.
beats.shot: Wide shot of an empty city street after rain, neon signs reflecting on wet asphalt, a single car driving through the middle of the frame, slow camera dolly, deep blue and magenta light, cinematic.

beats.brief: The car stops at a red light. Stillness; the light holds on the driver.
beats.shot: Side view of the driver waiting at a red traffic light, red light washing over the windshield, rain drops on the glass, still and quiet, shallow focus, cinematic night.

beats.brief: The city ends; a highway runs into the dawn. Hold to the end.
beats.shot: Rear view of a car driving onto an empty highway leaving the city lights behind, the first pale light of dawn on the horizon, long straight road, calm, wide cinematic shot.

music.style: Slow synthwave instrumental, warm analog pads, a steady soft drum machine, a lonely lead melody, 90 bpm, night-time driving mood.
